The verifier: 
- x0 = all indices of I.
- x1 = corners(x0) = four corners of the whole grid indices.
- x2 = mapply(dneighbors, x1) = the 4-neighbors of the corner cells (the cells adjacent to corners).
- x3 = toobject(x2, I) = object with colors at those neighbor cells.
- x4 = mostcolor(x3) = most common color among those corner-neighbor cells. These are typically the background color (0), since corners are surrounded by 0.
- x5 = palette(I) = all colors.
- x6 = remove(x4, x5) → colors excluding background.
- x7 = order(x6, identity) sorted.
- x8 = first = smallest color (the "single squares" color, e.g., 9 in example... wait in example, 4 is the shape color, 9 is single squares color. smallest = 4? Let's check: colors present 0,4,9. remove 0 → {4,9}. first = 4, last = 9.
- x10 = ofcolor(I, 4) = indices of shape color.
- x11 = ofcolor(I, 9) = indices of single squares.
- x12 = switch(I, 9, 4) → swaps colors 9 and 4.
- x13 = combine(x10, x11) = union of the shape color indices and single-square indices (in original grid coords).
- x14 = subgrid(x13, x12) = crop of the switched grid to bounding box of those combined indices.
- x15 = trim(x14) = remove border (1 cell).

So the output: the bounding box region containing the shape plus the four corner markers, with colors swapped (shape becomes 9, markers become 4), then trim the border.

Wait, in the example, output has size 8x4. Input region: shape color 4 spans rows 9..15, cols 3..6 roughly; markers 9 at (8,2),(8,7),(17,2),(17,7). Combined indices bounding box rows 8..17, cols 2..7 → height 10, width 6. Crop → 10x6, trim → 8x4. Yes matches output 8 rows x 4 cols.

So for item 1: colors present: 0, 2, 3. remove 0 → {2,3}. first=2, last=3. So x8=2 (single squares color), x9=3 (shape color). Wait, in example, smallest color 4 was the shape, and larger 9 was markers. Here smaller is 2 = markers, larger 3 = shape. Hmm, so which is which depends on values. Let's just follow: x10 = ofcolor(I, 2) (markers), x11 = ofcolor(I, 3) (shape). x12 = switch(I, 3, 2): swap 3↔2. x13 = combine(markers indices, shape indices). subgrid bounding box, trim.
